shortDescription: A framework for magical "entad" items: randomly rolled, rarity-scaled traits on weapons, apparel and furniture that reveal themselves through use, can be bound to a pawn's bloodline, and give durability, moods, abilities, damage effects and building bonuses.
body:
## Binding (EntadBinding.cs)
- An entad can be bound to one or more pawns (`CompEntad.Bind`, `EntadApi.Bind/Unbind/GetBoundPawns/TraitsActiveFor`, dev actions "Bind Entad to pawn" / "Unbind Entad"). Unbound = traits work for everyone.
- Bound items work as ordinary items for anyone; traits only work and reveal for bound pawns and their descendants (Parent relations, BFS depth 16, cached per pawn per item).
- Gated per user: wearer stats, held-item stats, damage and weapon effects, abilities, equipped hediffs, equipped/furniture/kill moods, meals, reveals, furniture abilities. Always on: durability, market value, building properties, unheld items, turret guns.
- `bindOnFirstUse`: first player-faction pawn to equip or use it for themselves (never during generation).
- WorldPawnGC keeps bound pawns and their descendants. Discarded pawns filtered on save.
- UI: inspect "Bound to" (full names), info card row (red when holder is outside the bloodline; damage rows hidden for them), traits tooltip note, alert "Entad bound to another bloodline" for colonists and slaves incl. caravans.

## Weapon effects (EntadWeaponTraits.cs, stage 1)
- `weaponProperties` (rolled, rarity-scaled like building factors): BurstShotCount factor (round up), BurstShotSpeed factor (divides ticks between shots), StoppingPower offset. Burst properties only on weapons that already burst; stopping power only on projectile weapons.
- `ignoreAccuracyMaluses`: weather accuracy, weather range cap, blind smoke (hit chance, target search, gizmo note), the same four sites vanilla checks for unique weapons.
- `equippedHediffs`: added to the brain on equip (Grant), removed on unequip unless other active gear gives them. Reveal kind `Hediff`, revealed on equip.
- `killThought`: plain non-social memory on each kill via ThingComp.Notify_KilledPawn (killer = wielder). Reveals the Mood kind.
- Weapon properties and accuracy reveal with the Damage kind (when a shot lands). Card shows rows in the weapon section and tooltip lines.
- Patches on Verb.BurstShotCount / TicksBetweenBurstShots, Projectile.Launch, ShotReport.HitReportFor, VerbProperties.AdjustedRange, AttackTargetFinder.BestAttackTarget, VerbTracker.CreateVerbTargetCommand. Each exits on a static "any trait uses this" flag first.
- `partialStats`: a trait may roll on items where only some of its stats apply; the others are hidden on the card.
- New traits: Rapid Volley, Quickfire, Impact Rounds, Stormsight, Battle Joy (+ Entad_Thought_BattleJoy).
- Not done yet: reloadable abilities.

## Durability
- MaxHitPoints × `EntadSettings.Durability[highest trait rarity]` (defaults 1.25/1.5/2/3/5). Never hidden. HP keeps its fraction on changes.

## Furniture mood (EntadMoods.cs)
- Prefix on `Pawn_JobTracker.CleanupCurrentJob`: work/recreation/own use at chairs, beds, eating tables. `Thought_EntadFurniture` keyed by thingIDNumber; longer expiry wins at the stack cap.

## Random mood traits
- `MoodCandidates`: single visible-stage plain memories from all mods; no traits/genes/hediffs/gender/expectation requirements, adult-stage allowed, no chains or placeholders.

## Localization
- All player text keyed `EF_` in `Languages/English/Keyed/EntadFramework.xml`. Debug actions and logs stay English.

## Settings
- Tabs General / Rarity and durability / Traits; trait list shows rarity or "Variable"; search covers stats, properties, abilities, fuels, damage, weapon effects, hediffs, kill moods.

## Save compatibility
- Removed traits map through `Patch_BackCompatibleDefName`; traits re-roll on load when their saved name differs or the stored value lists no longer match the def.

## Planned
- Stage 1 remainder: reloadable abilities (charges refilled by ammo through the vanilla reload job).
- Stage 2: Persona trait (bindOnFirstUse, vanilla bondedWeapon slot and equip lock, bonded hediffs/thoughts, Jealous, patch ThoughtWorker_WeaponTraitBonded).
- Stage 3: an EntadTraitDef per WeaponTraitDef (commonality → rarity, exclusionTags → conflicts, call its Worker).
- Stage 4: intercept unique/persona weapon creation and make plain-def entads; settings default on, DLC-gated, "exactly like vanilla" sub-setting.

## Open items
- Def hot-reload doesn't re-run the injectors.
- Lineage cache isn't invalidated if a mod adds parent relations mid-game.
- Kill moods also fire on slaughter and hunting kills (same as vanilla kill thoughts).
